text: # Examination Section Circular 2024-25

## Exam Registration & Form Submission Guidelines
All undergraduate and postgraduate students are hereby notified that the examination registration portal for the upcoming End Semester Winter Examination will be open from 1st October to 20th October 2024.
Students must verify all enrolled course codes, branch details, and elective subjects before final submission of the exam form.
Late submissions will incur a late fee of Rs 500 up to 25th October 2024, after which no examination forms will be entertained under any circumstances.

## Timetable and Hall Tickets
The final examination timetable will be officially released on the college student portal two weeks prior to the commencement of theory examinations. Hall tickets will be issued only to candidates with at least 75 percent minimum attendance across all enrolled subjects.
Remedial and supplementary examinations for students with ATKT backlogs will take place concurrently with regular semester examinations.
# સેન્ટ્રલ લાઈબ્રેરી પરિપત્ર: પુસ્તકાલય નિયમો અને સેવાઓ

## લાઈબ્રેરીનો સમય અને રીડિંગ હોલ સુવિધા
કોલેજ સેન્ટ્રલ લાઈબ્રેરી સોમવારથી શનિવાર સવારે 8:00 થી સાંજે 8:00 વાગ્યા સુધી કાર્યરત રહેશે. પરીક્ષા સમયગાળા દરમિયાન વિદ્યાર્થીઓની સુવિધા માટે રીડિંગ હોલ રાત્રે 11:00 વાગ્યા સુધી ખુલ્લો રાખવામાં આવશે.
રવિવાર તથા જાહેર રજાઓના દિવસે લાઈબ્રેરી બંધ રહેશે, પરંતુ ડિજિટલ લાઈબ્રેરી પોર્ટલ વિદ્યાર્થીઓ માટે 24 કલાક ઉપલબ્ધ છે.

## પુસ્તક વિતરણ અને આઈડી કાર્ડ નિયમો
દરેક અંડરગ્રેજ્યુએટ વિદ્યાર્થી પોતાના માન્ય કોલેજ આઈડી કાર્ડ પર મહત્તમ 3 પુસ્તકો 14 દિવસની મુદત માટે ઈશ્યુ કરાવી શકે છે. નિયત મુદત કરતાં મોડું પુસ્તક પરત કરવા બદલ દિવસ દીઠ 2 રૂપિયા દંડ આકારવામાં આવશે. સંદર્ભ ગ્રંથો માત્ર રીડિંગ હોલમાં વાંચવા માટે જ મળશે.
# छात्र कल्याण अनुभाग: छात्रावास प्रवेश एवं अनुशासन नियम

## छात्रावास कमरा आवंटन एवं शुल्क
कॉलेज परिसर में लड़कों और लड़कियों के लिए अलग-अलग छात्रावास की सुविधा उपलब्ध है। छात्रावास का वार्षिक शुल्क 36,000 रुपये है जिसमें आवास, बिजली और इंटरनेट वाई-फाई शामिल है।
मेस शुल्क 3,500 रुपये प्रति माह निर्धारित है, जिसका भुगतान प्रत्येक माह की 5 तारीख से पहले मेस सचिव को करना अनिवार्य है। भोजन में शुद्ध शाकाहारी नाश्ता, दोपहर का भोजन और रात्रि भोज शामिल है।

## छात्रावास अनुशासन नियम
हॉस्टल के मुख्य प्रवेश द्वार का समय रात 9:30 बजे बंद होने का है। किसी भी छात्र को वार्डन की पूर्व लिखित अनुमति के बिना रात में बाहर रहने की अनुमति नहीं दी जाएगी। अनुशासनहीनता या रैगिंग गतिविधियों में लिप्त पाए जाने पर तत्काल निष्कासन की कार्रवाई की जाएगी।
# Academic Affairs: Academic Calendar & Holiday Schedule

## Semester Timeline & Working Days
The odd semester commences on 15th July 2024 and concludes on 30th November 2024. A minimum of 90 instructional working days will be completed before theory examinations.
The mid-semester internal examinations will be conducted between 15th September and 22nd September 2024 for all departments including CSE, IT, Mechanical, and Civil Engineering.

## Vacation and Declared Holidays
The college will observe official holidays on Independence Day (15th August), Raksha Bandhan (19th August), and Gandhi Jayanti (2nd October).
The annual Diwali vacation will be observed for two full weeks starting from 28th October to 10th November 2024. Regular classes will resume promptly on 11th November 2024.
# Accounts Section Circular: Annual Fee Structure & Payment Notice

## Tuition and Semester Fee Structure
The annual tuition fee for BTech Computer Engineering, Information Technology, and Electronics Engineering is Rs 85,000 per academic year, payable in two equal semester installments of Rs 42,500 each.
In addition to tuition fees, students must pay an annual laboratory fee of Rs 8,000, library caution deposit of Rs 3,000 (one-time refundable), and college development fees of Rs 5,000.

## Online Fee Payment Instructions
All fee payments must be executed strictly online through the college ERP portal (https://erp.college.edu) using NetBanking, Debit/Credit Card, or official UPI payment gateway. Cash and offline cheque payments are not accepted at the cashier counter.
Students eligible for post-matric scholarships or MYSY scholarship schemes must submit their provisional scholarship approval sanction letters to the accounts section before the installment deadline.
